concerns.text: The specification omits any requirement to compute and report the Pearson correlation coefficient between the student‑only heuristic scores (token entropy $H_t$ and context stability $S_t$) and the original teacher‑student confidence‑gap scores. The idea explicitly states this analysis is needed to validate whether the teacher signal adds value, and Constitution Principle VII mandates it. Add a functional requirement (e.g., FR‑007) and corresponding success criterion to capture this correlation analysis.
